description: Each dataset keeps its own tracking objects and anomaly types.

anomaly_definitions.person_running: A person moves much faster than the local pedestrian baseline.
anomaly_definitions.person_chasing: Two or more people show sustained high-speed following or pursuit.
anomaly_definitions.person_fighting: People stay close with abrupt reciprocal motion that suggests conflict.
anomaly_definitions.person_falling_or_lying: A person changes from upright motion to a low or horizontal state, or remains lying.
anomaly_definitions.person_jumping_or_climbing: A person shows abrupt vertical motion or moves across normally non-walkable structures.
anomaly_definitions.person_loitering_or_reversal: A person remains unusually stationary, wanders, or reverses repeatedly in a way that deviates from normal flow.
anomaly_definitions.person_interaction: Abnormal close interaction not covered by chasing or fighting.
anomaly_definitions.vehicle_or_rideable_intrusion: A bicycle, motorcycle, car, vehicle, or skateboard appears or moves abnormally in a pedestrian scene.

anomaly_definitions.person_running: A person moves much faster than the normal walkway baseline.
anomaly_definitions.person_jumping: A person performs abrupt vertical motion or jumps in the walkway scene.
anomaly_definitions.person_falling_or_lying: A person falls, lies down, or remains in a low/horizontal state.
anomaly_definitions.person_loitering_or_wrong_direction: A person stays unusually long, wanders, or moves against the dominant walkway flow.
anomaly_definitions.person_object_throwing: A person throws an object or shows a clear throwing-like interaction.
anomaly_definitions.person_abnormal_object_interaction: A person carries, drops, picks, or manipulates an abnormal visible object.
anomaly_definitions.bicycle_intrusion_or_abnormal_ride: A bicycle appears or moves abnormally in the Avenue walkway scene.
anomaly_definitions.object_throwing: A thrown object is visible or inferable from person-object motion.
anomaly_definitions.abnormal_object: A visible object appears abnormal for the walkway scene, even when its exact class is weak.

anomaly_definitions.person_running: A person moves much faster than the local campus pedestrian baseline.
anomaly_definitions.person_chasing: Two or more people show sustained high-speed following or pursuit.
anomaly_definitions.person_fighting: People stay close with abrupt reciprocal motion that suggests conflict.
anomaly_definitions.person_falling_or_lying: A person changes from upright motion to a low or horizontal state, or remains lying.
anomaly_definitions.person_jumping_or_climbing: A person shows abrupt vertical motion or moves across normally non-walkable structures.
anomaly_definitions.person_loitering_or_reversal: A person remains unusually stationary, wanders, or reverses repeatedly in a way that deviates from normal flow.
anomaly_definitions.person_conflict: A broader campus conflict event involving one or more tracked people.
anomaly_definitions.bag_interaction: An abnormal interaction with a bag-like object when the detector exposes enough evidence.
anomaly_definitions.cycling_violation: A bicycle appears or moves abnormally in a pedestrian/campus region.
anomaly_definitions.vehicle_violation: A car, motorcycle, bus, or truck appears or moves abnormally in a campus region.
anomaly_definitions.animal_intrusion: A dog appears or moves abnormally in the monitored campus scene.
